answer_2.quote: We measure Mean Average Precision (MAP) for document and snippet retrieval, which are the official BIOASQ evaluation measures.

answer_4.quote: At the end of each BIOASQ annual contest, the biomedical experts who prepared the questions and their gold documents and snippets inspect the responses of the participants.
answer_4.guideline: If any of the documents and snippets returned by the participants are judged relevant to the corresponding questions, they are added to the gold responses.
